subsample with every column independently permuted across rows. Held fixed — the sequences, each
column's exact base-and-gap composition, `#=GC SS_cons`, the alignment width, `E ≤ 0.05`, the binary.
Varied — only the correlation *between* columns. **PASS: positive 8 helices / max 4 covarying pairs in
one helix / 13 total; control the same 8 helices with identical coordinates and base-pair counts and
0 covarying pairs everywhere.** Suite **1,945 passed / 158 skipped** with the binary present, against a
like-for-like `main` baseline of **1,915 / 158** — **+30, zero regressions**. Three sabotage reverts
each bit the test *named* for the invariant (`^FAILED` grepped): criterion-always-true killed
`test_designed_control_separates_under_every_criterion[within_helix]`; **availability-hardcoded-`True`
— the precise tautology this step exists to remove — killed
`test_readiness_refuses_when_the_binary_is_absent` and
`test_availability_cannot_be_forced_by_an_argument`**; a dead parser killed both criteria's control
tests. The armed gate also caught a real bug during development: `_VERSION_RE` matched the banner's
title line and reported the version as `::`.

**Decisions.** ADR-0002 **A11** (signed 2026-07-20) records the env. A **separate** env because
`rscape` pulls `gnuplot`'s Qt5/GStreamer closure: amending `envs/infernal.yml` would take it 39 → 135
packages and force a re-solve of the lockfile the **GATE-1 recall claim** is measured against, for no
saving (the standalone env is 125 packages either way). `infernal` 1.1.5 is pinned in the new env at
the **same build string** (`pl5321h7b50bb2_4`); the feared `esl-afetch`/`esl-reformat` collision was
settled by a **real co-install** (exit 0; both toolchains report their pinned versions afterwards), not
by a solver dry-run. Version **2.0.4.a is the newest build bioconda ships** while upstream is
**v2.6.11** — approved **for the mining protective filter only**, because v2.0.5 recalculated the
covariation power curves, which makes the version a methods-section fact; ADR-0006 D2's *reported* (a)
criterion at GATE-3/P6 must re-decide it (D8 bump trigger).

**Left open, recorded not hidden.** Two things.
(1) **The env + caller are necessary but not sufficient.** R-scape scores an *alignment*, never a
single sequence, and ADR-0006 D2→D7 require the model-independent one. The repo has **no
homolog-search target database** (`data/external` is 81 MB of T-box-specific FASTA; no RefSeq/GTDB/nt)
and **no `hmmer`/`blast` in any env**, so no per-candidate verdict is producible yet. That is
**P2-10c′**, sequenced with P6-01, and it is why the availability probe has no override argument.
(2) **"any-helix" admits two operators and neither is pinned.** `WITHIN_HELIX` (≥2 covarying pairs
inside one helix) and `TOTAL_ACROSS_HELICES` (≥2 summed across helices) are not equivalent. Measured on
seeded subsamples of the class-II alignment they agree on high-power inputs (0 % divergence at 5–8 and
60 sequences) and **disagree on up to 33 %** of low-power ones (10/12/15/20/30 sequences: 17 %, 25 %,
17 %, 33 %, 8 %) — the regime a real candidate's homolog set occupies. Every divergent case is one the
looser operator spares and the stricter one sends to the mining pool, so the choice is directly a
Tier-2N-protection choice. `AnyHelixCriterion` therefore has **no default** and `covariation_verdict`
requires it positionally; `CovariationResult.as_report` records the counterfactual verdict. Pinning one
is an **ADR-0006 decision owed at P2-10e**.

**Commit.** squash **`b2a2000`** on `main` (PR [#65](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/65)).

**CodeRabbit r1 — 3 Major + 2 nits, all applied.** The Major that mattered undercut A11's own
narrative: **the pinned version was documented everywhere and asserted nowhere it was used.**
`backend_available()` checked only that *some* `R-scape` was on `PATH`, and `as_report()` stamped
`PINNED_RSCAPE_VERSION` **unconditionally** — so a 2.6.x binary could have produced the numbers while
every committed report claimed 2.0.4.a, which is precisely the field this step argued a reader most
needs to be true. Now: availability is presence **and** version (a mismatch reads *unavailable*, so
the readiness gate refuses the round — the fail-closed direction); `CovariationResult` carries the
**observed** version (`None` for a parse, which is no evidence of what ran) and the report publishes
`rscape_version_observed` / `_pinned` / `_matches_pin`; `run_rscape` refuses an unpinned build outright;
and `scripts/make_rscape_fixture.py` checks the pin **before** overwriting tracked fixtures. Second
Major: the fixture generator wrote incrementally, so a failure on the second R-scape run would leave a
fresh positive beside a stale control — a **mismatched pair that still looks matched**, the one thing
the gate cannot tolerate; all four files are now staged in a temp dir and moved only after both runs
succeed. Third: the reproduction test claimed "byte-for-byte" while comparing only parsed helices, so a
changed p-value or aggregation mode would have slipped through — it now diffs the raw file. Two
sabotage reverts confirm the new invariants bite by name
(`test_an_unpinned_build_reads_as_unavailable`, `test_report_never_claims_a_version_it_did_not_observe`).
Suite **1,948 / 158** (+3); fixtures re-verified byte-identical after the rewrite.

**CodeRabbit r2 — 2 Major applied (a third was lost to the rate limit; see below).** Both were the
same shape as r1's: a path that could fail **open**. (a) `rscape_version()` let
`subprocess.TimeoutExpired` and `OSError` escape while `backend_available()` caught only
`CovariationBackendError`, so a hung or unexecutable binary would have **crashed the readiness probe**
instead of refusing the round; every probe failure is now a `CovariationBackendError` and the version
probe has its own 60 s budget rather than inheriting the 15-minute run ceiling. (b) `run_rscape` read
`<outname>.helixcov` from a caller-supplied `outdir` **without checking it was fresh** — and R-scape
exits 0 without writing when an alignment carries no `SS_cons`, so a reused outdir would have parsed an
earlier candidate's file as this one's verdict (a stale `passed` on a candidate never scored). It now
refuses a pre-existing output outright. `run_rscape` also gained the same `OSError` arm.
Two more sabotage reverts confirm both bite by name. Suite **1,951 / 158** (+3).
**Honest gap:** CodeRabbit reported **3** findings in r2 and the CLI's incremental mode plus a Fair-Usage
rate limit (34-minute wait, escalating per the known pattern) meant the third was never re-read. The two
recovered were fixed; the third is unread, not dismissed, and the same fail-open class was self-audited
across the run path (that audit is what added `run_rscape`'s `OSError` arm, which CodeRabbit had only
flagged on the probe).

**Independent adversarial audit (6 agents, 0 failures) — 11 confirmed defects, all fixed.** Because
CodeRabbit's r2 reported 3 findings and the rate limit meant only 2 were readable, I ran a three-lens
read-only audit (fail-open paths / parser / tests) with a refuting verifier per lens. It found more than
the missing finding, including one that undercut this step's own headline claim.

**The one that mattered — the designed control's matchedness was asserted nowhere.** Both "the control
is matched" tests compared only R-scape's `# RM` helix geometry — and geometry is a function of
`#=GC SS_cons` and the gap pattern, which `make_rscape_fixture.py` copies **verbatim** into both arms.
So matchedness was guaranteed-looking by construction rather than checked: the suite stayed green with
the control `.sto` replaced by a copy of the positive, and with **both `.sto` files deleted outright**.
The gate's claim — *"a separation here can only be covariation"* — would have been false, and silently,
under any regeneration that preserved the gap pattern while destroying per-column composition. The
fixtures were verified to be genuinely matched (0/1460 columns differing); the property is now
**asserted** from the alignments themselves (identical ordered names, width, `SS_cons`/`RF`, per-column
`Counter`, N=60, and control ≠ positive), and `column_shuffle` — the function that *creates* the
matchedness — gained its own test file. This is the P2-10b lesson recurring inside the file that cites it.

**The second fail-open, one layer below the module's stated purpose.** Covariation detection is
power-limited, and R-scape reports an alignment too shallow to *show* covariation exactly as it reports
one that genuinely does not covary: all `nbp_cov = 0` ⇒ `failed` ⇒ **minable**. That is precisely the
"the backend failed this candidate" vs "nothing was ever evaluated" conflation `spare_rule.py` exists to
prevent, reintroduced at the layer below it — and this step's own sweep already measured the regime as
decisive (**0/12** subsamples passing at 5–8 sequences vs **12/12** at 60), with a real candidate's
homolog set landing in the low band. `covariation_verdict` now takes a keyword-required `min_sequences`
with **no default** (the same device as `AnyHelixCriterion`, and ADR-0006 D2's carve-out already
anticipates it — "with a minimum-covariation-power caveat reported"); below it the call raises, so the
caller records `unavailable` and the candidate is **spared**. `n_sequences` is recorded in every report
regardless, so a committed round can be re-graded against whatever floor is eventually pinned.
**The numeric value is a third open ADR-0006 item for P2-10e**, alongside the operator choice.

**Also fixed.** A multi-MSA input silently returned the *last* alignment's verdict (R-scape rewrites
`<outname>.helixcov` once per alignment) — reproduced end-to-end; now refused, plus `--onemsa`. The
`# RMs = N` header R-scape writes in every file was discarded instead of cross-checked against the
records parsed, so any record the regex missed deflated `nbp_cov` into a false `failed`. `as_report`
claimed an `evalue` the parsed text never evidenced — the *same* defect as the version stamp fixed in
r1, and `-E` could be deleted from the argv with every test still green. `text=True` let
`UnicodeDecodeError` escape the "every probe failure becomes `CovariationBackendError`" contract. Four
`run_rscape` guards had no test anywhere — including the version-mismatch refusal — and two tests used
bare `pytest.raises` that could not distinguish the branch they were named for.

**Two of my own new tests did not bite, and sabotage is why I know.** The row-shuffle discriminator
compared *sorted* per-row compositions — sorting throws away exactly the reordering it was meant to
detect, so a row permutation passed it. And the depth guard's only test lived in the ml tier, which
skips without the binary, so deleting the guard left bare CI green. Both rewritten; all three re-run
sabotages now fail the test **named** for the invariant. Suite **1,974 / 158** vs the like-for-like
`main` baseline **1,915 / 158** = **+59, zero regressions**; fixtures still byte-identical.

**CodeRabbit r3 — 2 findings, both applied; the review gate is closed.** (a) *Major:* fixture
publication was still not transactional — the r2 fix staged all four files in a temp dir but then moved
them into place **one at a time**, so an interruption partway through left a mixed-generation set on
disk: the same stale-control state the staging exists to prevent, merely relocated to a later moment.
Publication now backs up the current generation, moves all four, and **rolls the whole set back** if any
single move fails. (b) *Minor, and mine:* the row-shuffle test's second clause was written as
`<composition clause> or <the set clause asserted on the line above>` — satisfied by that earlier line
no matter what the composition clause said, i.e. an assertion that could never fail. It is now an
independent per-row-composition multiset comparison, and was re-sabotaged with the set clause deleted to
confirm it carries the row-shuffle detection **on its own**. Suite **1,974 / 158** unchanged; fixtures
byte-identical; ruff/black/`snakemake --lint`/DAG dry-run clean; all four GitHub Actions checks green.

## Step P2-10d — 2026-07-20: mined-negative injection + warm start in Stage-1 training

**Inputs.** `train_stage1::build_stream`/`build_model`/`_train_stage1_inner`, `conf/train/stage1.yaml`,
P2-01's `window_dataset` (`CorpusRecord`, `carve_window`, `WeightedIndexSampler`, `curriculum_weights`),
P2-10b's `data/processed/negatives/mining_pool_v0.parquet` (46,591 coordinate-bearing windows), P2-09's
round-0 production checkpoint `data/processed/checkpoints/stage1_production/stage1.pt`, PRD §9.1,
ADR-0005 D14.

**Process.** New module `src/tbox_finder/data/negatives.py`: `background_record()` builds an
all-background `CorpusRecord` whose pseudo-locus is co-extensive with the window, so a negative reaches
the model down the *same* carve as a positive and emits 1,024 real nucleotides labelled `background`
with no `IGNORE_INDEX` and no `[PAD]`; `MixedIndexSampler` interleaves negatives into the draw stream at
a configured share and `mix_summary()` **counts the emitted keys** to report the realized one;
`positive_only_sampler()` restricts the PRD §11 curriculum to the dataset's positive prefix and
*verifies* the boundary. In `train_stage1`: `warm_start()` loads a parent `state_dict` (`strict=True`)
and returns a per-tensor sha256 measurement taken around the load; `build_model` gained the warm-start
path and a fifth return value; `cfg.eval_at_step0` scores the P2-06a ladder before the first optimiser
step (placed before `reset_peak_memory_stats`, so eval activations stay out of the §10.3 training VRAM
figure); `batch_plan()` was split out of `_batches` so the mix is measured on the very keys the loop
consumes. Five new CLI-overridable fields landed in **both** the dataclass **and**
`conf/train/stage1.yaml`, gated by a new composition test.

**Outputs.** `src/tbox_finder/data/negatives.py` (new); `train_stage1` gains `warm_start`,
`_state_digests`, `batch_plan`, `ShardedSampler.inner`, report blocks `negative_mix{stream,consumed}` /
`warm_start` / `eval_metrics_step0` / `eval_scope_step0` / `step0_requested`, and two gate clauses
`negative_mix_realized` + `warm_start_loaded`; report `SCHEMA_VERSION` 1 → 2 with
`CLAUSE_SCHEMA_VERSION`; `reports/p2/negative_injection.json` (the measured substrate audit);
tests `tests/unit/test_negatives.py`, `tests/unit/test_p2_10d_clauses.py`, `tests/ml/test_warm_start.py`,
`tests/ml/test_negative_injection.py`, plus `test_sbatch_overrides.py::test_p2_10d_fields_are_config_keys_and_dataclass_fields`.

**Validation.** Both gates PASS, restated as exact identities rather than tolerances. **Mix:** the
counted negative keys must equal `round(n_positive · f/(1−f))` re-derived from the *counted* positive
keys — no tolerance knob exists to loosen — and the requested-zero branch asserts an empty pool and zero
draws rather than skipping. On the real corpus (`tests/ml/test_negative_injection.py`, 100 positives ×
200 negatives at f = 10/11) the emitted stream is exactly 100 / 1,000, every key counted negative
indexes a negative record, and the positive sub-stream is **identical** to the positives-only run's, so
P2-06's ranking and P2-09's checkpoint stay reproducible. **Warm start:** every model tensor byte-equal
to the parent's after the load (0 missing / 0 unexpected / 0 shape-mismatch), with two designed controls
— a fresh model must *not* match, and its forward must *differ* — and the warm-started forward is
bit-identical to the parent's, which is "reproduces its parent's metrics at step 0" in the only form
that is decidable without a GPU: identical parameters on identical inputs cannot yield different
metrics. The real P2-09 checkpoint's head keys and shapes fit the shipped `concat`/no-CRF skeleton.
Suite **2,017 passed / 189 skipped**, 2,206 collected vs `main`'s 2,132 = **+74, zero regressions**;
ruff + black clean.

**Decisions.** (1) *Negatives bypass the PRD §11 curriculum.* Routing them through it makes the realized
share `N^(1−3α)` — `N^0.25` at the shipped α = 0.25 — so a 10× larger pool moves the mix by only ~1.78×
while the config goes on stating a ratio the sampler contradicts. That is the `basis_point` defect in a
new costume, so the mix is a separate, counted draw stream and negatives carry a **private** stratum and
(negative) cluster namespace; a test measures that positive-vs-positive weights are unchanged to
`rtol = 1e-12`, with the shared-`UNKNOWN`-bucket control moving them by > 1e-3. (2) *Geometry is a
refusal.* A negative must be exactly one window of real DNA; padding a short one asserts a contig
boundary that does not exist and teaches "`[PAD]`-heavy ⇒ background", a cue absent from the scan
distribution. (3) *Schema versioning instead of regenerating artifacts.* Two new clauses would have
invalidated P2-04's and P2-09's committed reports; regenerating them to add the keys would forge
measurements those runs never made (§10.3). `validate_report` excuses a missing clause **only** for an
older `schema_version` **and only when it re-derives TRUE**, so an old report still cannot hide a
failure and a current-schema report must carry every clause — sabotaging either half fails the test
named for it.

**Measured blocker for P2-10e (this step's main empirical finding).** The hook lands; the 1,024-nt
substrate does not. `reports/p2/negative_injection.json`: of the mining pool's 46,591 rows, **0** are
injectable at the training window — 585 masked, 46,006 at 300 nt (`mining/pool.py::DEFAULT_WINDOW_NT`).
Re-carving wider does not fix it *at the shipped pad*: at margin 0 the corpus yields 45,519 carvable
1,024-nt flank windows, but at the D14 flank of 50 nt it yields **0**. P2-10e therefore needs a
wider-flank substrate (or a re-fetch), and `build_stream` refuses the current pool by name rather than
degrading to a positives-only run that reports a mix.

> **Correction (P2-10d′-a, 2026-07-21).** This paragraph originally read "P2-00 fetched **exactly
> 1,024 nt** of flank … a window that wide abuts its own parent locus and the union-prior mask removes
> every one." Both halves of the *cause* were wrong, and this step's own artifact contradicted the
> first: `reports/p2/negative_injection.json` recorded `max_trail_flank_nt: 1069`, with 8,898 rows
> carrying trail flank above 1,024. `DEFAULT_PAD_NT` pads the **named span**, and the anchored sequence
> is a strict sub-extent of it, so the realized flank routinely exceeds the pad. The per-record wall sat
> at margin **49** — a 5-nt miss, not arithmetic impossibility — and the mask claim was false for
> windows stitched across ≥ 2 fetched regions on one accession. The *conclusion* (no usable 1,024-nt
> substrate at the shipped pad) stands, and stood on scale rather than on impossibility. P2-10d′-a
> closed it by re-fetching at pad 1,074.

**Not decided here.** `negative_fraction` is a *stream share*, so PRD §9.1's "~10:1 seed ratio" reads as
f = 10/11; the shipped default is **0.0** and no round value is pinned. Pinning the round-0 fraction and
the round budget belongs to P2-10e's ADR-0005 amendment (CLAUDE.md §7 item 2), not to this step.

**Commit.** squash **`f27a7bf`** on `main` (PR [#66](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/66)); feature-branch commit, subject `feat(train): mined-negative injection hook + warm-start path`

**CodeRabbit r1 — 3 findings, all minor, all applied.** (a) The warm-start clause compared
`warm.checkpoint` to the raw config string while `warm_start` records `str(Path(...))`, so a config
spelt `./ckpt.pt` would have failed a load that in fact succeeded; both sides are now normalised, with
a test over three spellings plus a genuinely-different checkpoint. (b) The `max_records` break sat
*after* the append, so a cap of 0 emitted one record — a pool of size 1 beside a report saying
`max_records: 0`; moved before, with a test over caps 0/1/3/5/9. (c) `negative_mix_pool_consistent`
requires a non-empty draw whenever a fraction was requested, which a fraction small enough to round to
zero draws would have failed. CodeRabbit proposed relaxing the clause; I refused the *state* instead —
`MixedIndexSampler` now raises at construction, because a clause that admits a rounded-down zero also
admits a run that trained on no negatives at all while its report described a negative curriculum. The
boundary is tested in both directions (f = 0.001 over 10 positives refused; f = 0.05 accepted at
exactly 1 draw). Suite **2,020 / 189** (2,209 collected, **+77** vs `main`'s 2,132); ruff/black clean.

## Step P2-10d′-a — 2026-07-21: the wider-flank re-fetch, the 1,024-nt re-carve, and the `nested_train` parent-fold admission rule

**Inputs.** `data/interim/flank_context/context_v0.parquet` (23,535 rows, all `pad_nt = 1024`; the
resumable `fetch_cache.jsonl` was not on disk, so this was a full cold re-fetch of 23,535 NCBI requests,
not a top-up) · `workflow/rules/data.smk::p2_flank_context` · `conf/data/decoys.yaml` ·
`data/processed/splits/split_assignments.parquet` (git-LFS; PAR1 magic verified before use).

**Process.** Three changes, of which only the first is the one the step is named for and only the third
is the one that mattered. (1) `p2_flank_context` now passes `--pad-nt` — the flag has existed since
P2-00, the rule simply never passed it — with the value **derived** from the mining geometry
(`common.smk::flank_pad_nt` = `mining_window_nt + mining_margin_nt`) rather than restated, because a
duplicated pad drifts silently and the failure mode is an empty substrate rather than an error. The
helper lives in a new `workflow/rules/common.smk`: `snakemake --lint` refuses "Mixed rules and functions
in same snakefile", and a red lint is CI-blocking. (2) `conf/data/decoys.yaml` `mining_window_nt:
300 → 1024`, with `mining/pool.py::DEFAULT_WINDOW_NT` and `decoys._Config`'s fallback moved with it —
`read_config(None)` returns the bare object, so a default left at 300 would silently rebuild the pool at
a width from which no negative can be injected. (3) **The real deliverable.** `mining/pool.py` now joins
the committed split table and stamps every carved window with `parent_nested_train`, and
`negatives.load_negative_records` refuses any row whose parent is not in `nested_train`.

**Why (3) is the deliverable.** `background_record` stamps every injected negative `nested_train=True`
and `is_designated_loo_holdout=False`. Those are *assertions about the negative*, not checks on where its
DNA came from — and `genomic_window` is carved from the flank of **every** anchored corpus record,
held-out ones included. Measured on the shipped P2-10b pool: of 46,006 natural windows, **17,074
(37.1 %)** were carved beside a designated leave-one-order-out holdout locus, i.e. the immediate genomic
neighbourhood of the loci **GATE-4** grades, entering training stamped as training data. The CLAUDE.md
§8.2 CI gate is structurally blind to it — `test_no_leakage.py` reads the committed per-record split
table, and a runtime-injected negative appears in **no row of it**. The admission rule (user decision
2026-07-20) is symmetry with the positives: admissible iff the parent is in `nested_train`. Nothing
weaker is defensible — `excluded_clade_crossing` and `dropped` parents are withheld *because* their clade
membership is unsafe, so readmitting their DNA under a negative label readmits the taxon.

**Outputs.** `context_v0.parquet` re-fetched at pad **1,074** (`md5 ec214266…`, 23,535 rows) ·
`mining_pool_v0.parquet` re-carved at 1,024 nt with the new `parent_nested_train` column (`md5
c216409…`, **45,988** rows: lead 22,676 / trail 22,812 / control 500) · regenerated
`mining_pool_report.json`, `flank_context.json`, `negative_injection.json` · new
`tests/ml/test_negative_provenance.py` (the runtime gate) and `tests/unit/test_mining_window_config.py`
(the config↔code↔workflow pins, of which there were **none** — `grep mining_window_nt tests/` returned 0).

**Validation.** All five clauses of the step gate pass. `n_records` in `negative_injection.json`:
**0 → 15,708** injectable negatives at window 1,024. Designed control **500/500** with
`all_controls_exact` true (and overlap and masked). Natural residual contamination re-reported against
the union denominator **24,160** (24,157 loci loaded): **1,812/45,488 = 3.98 %**, up from 0.18 % at 300
nt — a 3.4× wider window has 3.4× more opportunity to intersect a masked locus, so the rise is
geometric, not a new contamination. **0** injectable negatives with a non-`nested_train` parent:
27,960 refused as `parent_not_nested_train`, **0** as `parent_fold_unknown` (all 23,132 distinct parents
resolved). Full-corpus no-leakage gate re-run as insurance: 25/25 green. Whole suite with every
`TBOX_REQUIRE_*` armed: **2,104 passed / 179 skipped / 0 failed**; `snakemake --lint`, `snakemake -n`,
black and ruff clean.

**Two measurements worth keeping.** (i) The first fetch pass lost **34** records to transient HTTP 429s
(`anchor_rate` 0.99847). The fetcher is resumable and retries `fetch_failed` by default, so a second
pass recovered all 34 and reproduced the committed composition **exactly**: 23,532 `ok` / 2 `multi_hit` /
1 `unavailable`, `anchor_rate` 0.99987. A wider pad did **not** cost anchoring — had the re-run been
skipped, the corpus would have shipped 33 records short with every test green. (ii) `n_full_window_capable`
is **23,253 at both pads**, and every P2-06a selection-val pin re-derives unchanged — 830 records / 469
blocks / 8,303 nested_train / 4,775 clusters / 7,472 inner_train. Training-window geometry is invariant
under the pad, so the P2-06 sweep and the P2-09 checkpoint remain comparable.

**Decisions.** The refusal lives at *load*, not at *carve*: out-of-fold windows stay in the artifact so
the natural-contamination denominator remains comparable across builds and the filter's own
discrimination is auditable from the artifact rather than only from the code that wrote it. The gate
therefore carries a **must-fire control** — `parent_fold_discriminates` requires
`n_parent_out_of_training_fold > 0`, gated on a number whose legitimate value can never be zero (the
corpus holds ~15.2k anchored non-`nested_train` records), so a join that silently matched nothing fails
loudly instead of reading as a clean corpus. Unresolved parents are counted and refused **apart** from
out-of-fold ones for the same reason. `CorpusRecord` gained a required `source_record_id` (no default,
for the reason `is_designated_loo_holdout` has none): the provenance test reads the parent as data
rather than parsing it out of an id string, and the fabricating default here — `record_id` — is right
for positives and silently wrong for exactly the records that matter.

**Sabotage.** The invariant test was proved to bite by name, not by suite colour. Admitting out-of-fold
parents (`if require_parent_nested_train and not bool(fold):` → `if False`) reddens
`^FAILED …::test_every_negative_build_stream_injects_is_training_fold_dna`; defaulting
`source_record_id` to the record's own id reddens the same test. Both restores verified byte-exact by
SHA-256 with `__pycache__` cleared and `-p no:cacheprovider`. The unit tier adds 23 further sabotage
cases across `mining/pool.py`, `decoys.py`, `data.smk` and `conf/data/decoys.yaml`, each matched to the
test named for it. The old blocker test was **rewritten, not deleted** — its `pytest.raises("supplied 0
injectable negatives")` is repointed at a deliberately 300-nt pool, so reverting the re-carve still goes
red.

**No ADR.** `pad_nt` is pinned nowhere (PRD §6 / ADR-0001 D31 / ADR-0005 D3 pin window = 1024 and
stride = 512; `flank_context.validate_report` enforces only `pad_nt >= window_nt`), and the parent-fold
filter *tightens* an existing pin (§9.2) rather than changing a number. §8.5's "can perturb cluster or
taxon membership" trigger is provably not met: clustering reads `FASTA_sequence` (`splits.py:406-412`),
`splits.py` has zero hits for flank/context, and `flank_context` *reads* the split table — splits are
upstream. The full-corpus gate was re-run anyway, and the selection-val pins above confirm it.

**Commit.** squash **`029b432`** on `main` (PR [#67](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/67)); feature-branch commit, subject `feat(mining): re-fetch flank at pad 1074 …`

**CodeRabbit r1 — 4 findings, all minor, all applied.** (a) `common.smk::flank_pad_nt` honoured a
`--config flank_pad_nt=` override unconditionally, so an override *below* the mining geometry would
spend the entire NCBI fetch and then produce a context from which `build_mining_pool` carves nothing —
the exact value P2-10d shipped by accident (1,024) is the obvious way to hit it. The override may now
only raise the pad, never lower it, and the guard is tested by **executing** `common.smk` with a stubbed
Snakemake `config` rather than text-scanning it (a scan asserting "the word `raise` appears" passes on a
guard comparing the wrong two numbers), with a must-not-fire companion so a guard that refused *every*
override cannot pass. (b) The build's stderr line paired `n_natural_windows_admissible` (natural-scoped)
with `n_parent_out_of_training_fold` (whole-pool, controls included), so "16,272 admissible / 29,542
refused" described 45,814 of 45,988 windows. The evidence block now carries the natural triple —
`n_natural_windows` / `_admissible` / `_out_of_fold`, which closes under addition — and the line quotes
that; the artifact's parquet is byte-identical, only the report moved. (c) `load_parent_folds` let a null
`nested_train` become `False` through `bool(None)`, collapsing "never assigned" into "out of fold" one
layer *below* the `n_unresolved_parent` counter that exists to keep them apart — it now refuses, with a
must-not-fire companion proving non-corpus rows stay out of scope. (d) A stale comment claiming the
`max_records` report key was still missing (it had been restored). Suite **2,110 / 179**, ruff/black/lint
clean.

## Step P2-10d′-b — 2026-07-21: the §9.1 seed-negative construction (R2 embedding + its matched junction control)

**Inputs.** P2-10d′-a's re-carved pool (`mining_pool_v0.parquet`, 45,988 windows @ 1,024 nt, 15,708
injectable) · `decoys_v0.parquet` (7,008 records, 4 classes, 57–550 nt) · `master_clean_v0.parquet` ·
`conf/train/stage1.yaml` · `slurm/p2/train_production.sbatch`.

**Process.** The step's Stop was the **ADR-0005 A7** sign-off, so it opened by measuring the two things
A7 could not be written without. First, whether the user's R2 embedding hands the model a junction cue:
`workflow/rules/data.smk`'s `p2_flank_context` docstring has already ruled that "a 0th-order background
splice would hand the model a trivially separable boundary cue", and R2 puts two junctions into
**negatives only**. A k-mer logistic probe (5-fold CV AUROC, n = 2,500/arm, seed 20260721) put the
background→background junction **on the measured null** — 0.487–0.494 at k=4 and 0.505–0.519 at k=6
against a 0.493/0.520 unspliced-vs-unspliced null, and 0.487–0.510 for a 128-nt window centred on the
junction itself. The earlier ruling was about a *0th-order synthetic* splice; real DNA spliced into real
DNA leaves no compositional trace. Second, whether the residual separability (0.71–1.00 for every class)
is host/insert GC mismatch: GC-matching the host cut mean |ΔGC| from 0.101 to **0.001** and separability
**did not fall**, so a GC-matched-host pin would buy nothing and was **not** proposed. Third — verified
directly against the corpus, not from a summary — **2 of the 8 `leader_decoy` records are exact
substrings of training positives** (`neg_tbdb_-1baL_Tx` in 2 of 23,535 records, `neg_tbdb_GwZsgp7s` in 2),
and the other 6 are T-box-derived too (`neg_anchor_6UFM`/`6UFG` are PDB class-II T-boxes by this repo's
own fixture README). The four contested pins were then put to the user with these measurements attached
and all four recommendations were signed off. Implementation: `data/embedding.py` (the equal-length
splice, the seeded placement, the matched control, the A7 pool pins), `eval/junction_probe.py` (the
two-tier gate), `scripts/measure_junction_control.py` (the shipped measurement), plus the training wiring
— `negative_decoy_parquet` in the dataclass **and** in `conf/train/stage1.yaml` (a dataclass field alone
is what killed job 669), and the sbatch's `negative_*` tokens with `--time` raised 01:00:00 → 05:00:00.
`negatives.admit_pool_rows` was **promoted** out of `negative_records_from_rows` so the embedding's hosts
pass the *same* §9.2 filter rather than a forked copy.

**Outputs.** `src/tbox_finder/data/embedding.py` · `src/tbox_finder/eval/junction_probe.py` ·
`scripts/measure_junction_control.py` · `reports/p2/junction_control.json` · `docs/decisions/ADR-0005 A7` ·
`tests/unit/test_embedding.py` (27) · `tests/unit/test_embedding_generator.py` (12) ·
`tests/unit/test_junction_probe.py` (34) · `tests/unit/test_negative_mix_composition.py` (14) ·
`tests/ml/test_junction_gate.py` (5).

**⚠ THE FIRST VALIDATION VERDICT IN THIS STANZA WAS WRONG — CORRECTED IN PLACE BELOW, ORIGINAL LEFT VISIBLE.**

**Validation (SUPERSEDED — read the correction).** **PASS.** `reports/p2/junction_control.json` `overall_pass: true`, all 4 clauses true at
**both** k over 4,999 embedded / 2,804 unspliced windows: k=4 null 0.5060 / junction **0.5179** / content
0.7394; k=6 null 0.5115 / junction **0.5058** / content 0.7599 (SE_H0 0.0077). Realized composition
15,708 plain + 4,999 embedded = **20,707** records (75.9 / 9.7 / 14.5 %), 2,008 decoys refused by A7
pins 4–5. Mix identity re-derived against hand-written literals: 8,303 → **83,030** draws, stream 91,333.
Suite **2,165 passed / 216 skipped**; ruff, black 25.11.0 and `snakemake --lint` clean.

**Three measurement artifacts caught by their own guards, recorded because each would have produced a
confident wrong number.** (a) The first probe shared host windows across arms; because every spliced
window is the pair of its own unspliced counterpart, a CV classifier that memorised a host scored its
pair in the opposite direction and **every junction AUROC came back below chance (0.25–0.45)**. Disjoint
hosts per arm fixed it — and because matchedness *requires* shared hosts while the AUROC *forbids* them,
`junction_measurement` now takes the control twice, in two named roles. (b) Hosts drawn with replacement
put duplicate-host near-duplicates in the spliced arms and none in the plain arm; that asymmetry alone
drove the fixture's junction arm to **0.70**. (c) The `plain`/`null_reference` overlap guard fired on the
real pool: **102 byte-identical windows** exist under distinct `candidate_id`s. None of the three was a
junction; all three would have read as one.

**Decisions.** ADR-0005 **A7** (9 pins; user sign-off 2026-07-21) — f = 10/11 as a *stream* share;
pool-proportional per-class shares with the mined `genomic_window` records serving §9.1's dominant class 1;
`gc_background` and `leader_decoy` to share 0 (the latter re-scoping a **D14** clause); the two-tier
junction gate with a threshold-free tier-2 rule ("the decoy must beat its own junction null"); cold
round-0; class weights over the mixed stream. Compute pre-registered in A7 (≈18–21 GPU-h) rather than
charged to ADR-0003 A2, which is a *sweep* bound. **The SLURM submit-ack is still open** — the training
run has not been launched.

**Commit.** squash **`748c4f2`** on `main` (PR [#68](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/68)).


> **Correction to the P2-10d′-b stanza (same day, before merge).** Two review findings and a
> re-measurement changed both the construction and the verdict above. **(1) A leakage gap.** The
> embedding filtered the *host* window's §9.2 fold but never the decoy's own: `dinuc_shuffled`
> records are Altschul–Erikson permutations of corpus positives sampled from all 23,535 records,
> and **1,298 of 2,000 (64.9 %)** have a parent outside `nested_train`. ADR-0005 A7 pin 6 claimed
> embedded negatives' provenance "cannot be weaker than a plain negative's"; it was. Fixed as
> **pin 6a** — a decoy carrying a `source_record_id` must have that parent in the training fold,
> and an unsupplied fold set refuses the row as *unverifiable* rather than admitting it.
> **(2) The junction claim was false, and the fix is what exposed it.** With the arms re-sized by
> pin 6a (embedded 4,999 → 3,701, unspliced 2,804 → 4,102) the measurement gained power, and the
> k=6 junction arm rose to **0.5328** against a null of 0.4947. Across **four independent draws**
> it is **0.5217 / 0.5264 / 0.5281 / 0.5328** against nulls of 0.4947–0.5042 — above its null
> every time. A splice junction is a chimera of two genomes and a 6-mer model can read it; the
> original 0.5058 was the lucky draw. Because R2 spliced **only negatives**, that cue was
> perfectly class-correlated.
>
> **What changed as a result (user decision 2026-07-21, "do 1").** The cue is now removed **by
> construction** rather than bounded by measurement: positive windows receive the same
> background→background splice, from the same insert-length distribution, at a rate *derived*
> from the negative arm (**3,701 / 19,409 = 0.19069**), so P(chimeric | positive) equals
> P(chimeric | negative). The splice overwrites only positions already background-labelled and
> already real, equal-length, and draws from an RNG salted apart from the lead/strand stream — so
> it moves no label, invents no DNA at a contig end, and re-phases no prior run. The failing
> `junction_within_null_band` clause is **retained and reported** in
> `reports/p2/junction_control.json` (flagged `junction_is_visible_at_k6: true`) rather than
> quietly dropped; the gate that replaces it is arithmetic
> (`junction_symmetry_clauses`: derived rate, zero moved labels, realized rates agree, and a
> must-fire control that must FAIL with the augmentation disabled).
>
> **Corrected composition.** 15,708 plain + **3,701** embedded = **19,409** negative records
> (80.9 / 15.5 / 3.6 %); refusals 2,008 by pins 4–5, **1,298 by pin 6a**, 1 masked.
> **Corrected validation:** `overall_pass: true` on the *gated* clauses (`arms_are_matched`,
> `probe_can_discriminate`) at both k, with `junction_within_null_band` recorded **false at k=6**
> as the finding. Suite **2,203 passed / 216 skipped**. Sabotage-verified in both directions: an
> inert augmentation reds 4 named tests, and letting the splice ignore the label reds the
> DNA-under-labelled-positions assertion — which the label-equality check alone could **not**
> see, since `labels` is a separate array and overwriting a Stem-II position leaves its label
> intact over donor DNA.
>
> **Still open:** the SLURM submit-ack. No training run has been launched.

## Step P2-10d′-c — 2026-07-21: the pre-ack probes that stopped the launch — a pandas dialect that deleted a pinned decoy class, and a stale-output `rm` that fails the run's own gate

**Inputs.** `slurm/p2/train_production.sbatch` @ `748c4f2`, the five staged parquets, and the
`tbox-ml-dna` env on the cluster. **Process.** The §9.3 pre-ack sequence was run in full —
cluster synced to `main`, all five parquets verified *by executing the sbatch's own
`assert_dvc_artifact`/`assert_lfs_artifact` block* (5/5 `staged-ok`), the sbatch's *own*
`torchrun` argv extracted by shimming `torchrun` to echo its arguments and then composed through
Hydra → `_cfg_from_mapping` → `Stage1TrainConfig` in the target env (the job-669 probe:
`COMPOSE_OK`, `lr=3e-4`, γ=0.5, α=0.5, `init_from_checkpoint=None`), and
`sbatch --test-only` (*"Job 677 to start at 2026-07-21T10:28:24 … on nodes **one**"*). A
CPU-only `build_stream` dry run — added because a composition failure is invisible until after
the queue wait — then disagreed with the committed artifact, and a 22-agent adversarial audit of
the launch path found a second, unrelated defect. **Neither is visible to CI.**

**Finding 1 — a pandas dialect silently deleted a pinned decoy class, and filed it as leakage.**
`embedding.py` read a decoy's parent as `str(row.get(col) or "")`. Under **pandas 2.3.3**
(`envs/data.yml`, and CI's pin) a null string cell is `None` → `""` → *absent*. Under **pandas
3.0.3** — `envs/ml-dna.conda-lock.yml`, the env that actually trains — the default string dtype's
missing sentinel is `NaN`, which is **truthy**, so the same cell reads as the literal string
`"nan"`: a present-looking parent id in no fold set. `decoys_v0.parquet` carries that column null
in **5,008 of 7,008** rows. Measured on the cluster against the staged pools: `n_embedded`
**702** (`{dinuc_shuffled: 702}`, `structured_rna` **absent**) versus the committed
`junction_control.json`'s **3,701** (702 + 2,999); `decoy_parent_not_nested_train` **4,297** =
1,298 real + **2,999 spurious**; realized mix **16,410** instead of 19,409; and the
junction-symmetric splice rate — which A7 pin 7 *derives* from the negative arm — **0.04278
instead of 0.19069**. Because that rate is derived, **every clause still passed**: the run would
have shipped a checkpoint violating **A7 pin 3** with a green report, and the refusal would have
read as the §9.2 filter working. Two guards did not fire: `missing_wanted` stamps `seen_pools`
*before* every filter, so it proves only that the name was read; and `if not embedded` passes at
702 > 0.

**Finding 2 — the stale-output `rm` fails the run's own gate after the full ~20 GPU-h.**
`train_production.sbatch:192` deleted `reports/p2/train_stage1_production.json`, **git-tracked**
since `082f8c7`. `_provenance_complete` requires every dirty path to sit under
`_DATA_STAGING_PREFIXES = ("data/",)`, and `build_report` snapshots `git status` **once** while
the deletion is live. Measured on the cluster against the live tree: dirty = `[staged parquet]`
→ `True`; dirty = `[staged parquet, deleted report]` → **`False`**. The chain is
`provenance_complete` False → `overall_pass` False → `torch.save` **skipped** → the report
written over the committed P2-09 baseline carrying `overall_pass: false` → `RuntimeError` →
rc ≠ 0 → the EXIT trap wipes `$BUILD` with the checkpoint inside it. It had never fired because
job 671's report predates the clause (`schema_version 1`, no `git_dirty_paths` key).

**Outputs.** `masking.row_text` — one pandas-free missing-value boundary, promoted rather than
duplicated — now backs every nullable-column read in `data/embedding.py` and `data/negatives.py`;
`negatives.py`'s fold test moved from `fold is None` to `is_missing(fold)` (a NaN fold was
**truthy**, so a null `parent_nested_train` would have read as *in fold* — fail-open, latent only
because the shipped pool has no nulls there); a per-pool **admission** guard (gated on `per_pool`,
the count the records produce, never on the request) refuses a pinned pool that admits nothing;
`rm -f "$REPORT"` dropped in favour of an md5 **freshness fingerprint**, so nothing tracked is
deleted yet a stale report still cannot pass as this run's; and the stale SUBMIT recipe — which
named a branch deleted from origin and chained `git reset --hard` into `sbatch`, re-arming the
LFS-pointer trap — rewritten as sync → re-stage → submit.

**Validation.** Suite **2,214 passed / 222 skipped / 1 xfailed**; ruff, black, `snakemake --lint`
and `-n` clean. Five sabotages each redden **exactly one** test, matched **by name**: the two
`str(x or "")` reverts redden the NaN parametrisations, `fold is None` reddens the
unresolved-fold gate, removing the admission guard reddens
`test_a_pinned_pool_that_admits_nothing_is_refused`, and restoring the tracked-file `rm` reddens
`test_no_sbatch_deletes_a_git_tracked_path[train_production.sbatch]`. The NaN assertions use the
sentinel as a **literal**, so they bite under both dialects — the parquet round-trip test states
in its own docstring that it *cannot* discriminate under the CI pin. The suite's only prior
per-pool assertion had asserted `structured_rna == 0` — the bug's own value — and was **rewritten,
not deleted**.

**Decisions.** No ADR: the fix *restores* the composition A7 pin 3 already pins. The new gate
found a second offender, `sizing_smoke.sbatch` (16 tracked files), which is **not** fixed here —
its aggregation globs `POINT_DIR/*.json`, so merely not deleting would silently mix a previous
run's points into the report, and the correct fix (redirect `POINT_DIR` to node-local scratch)
cannot be executed or verified from the laptop. Shipping an unverified edit to a SLURM script is
the exact failure this step exists to catch, so it is recorded as an `xfail(strict=True)`: when it
is fixed the XPASS **fails** the suite and forces the entry out, so the exemption cannot rot green.

**Still open:** the SLURM submit-ack. No training run has been launched.

**Commit.** squash **`aaf33b0`** on `main` (PR [#69](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/69)); feature-branch commit on `p2-10d-prime-c`. *(Reconciled at the P2-15 exit gate: this stanza carried no `Commit.` line.)*

tier-1 clause, no composition clause, pin-9 positives-only counts) were offered as a fourth option and **not**
taken; they stay recorded under P2-10d′-b. No job was submitted. Everything mechanical was green today (node
`one` idle with 8 A4000s, cluster synced, `sbatch --test-only` → job 678 on `one`); only the two code defects
below stood between here and the ack.

**Process.** **Blocker C** — the same clause that killed the launch at P2-10d′-c (Blocker B), re-armed by a
different trigger. `build_report` runs on **all 8 ranks** (`train_stage1.py`), and its first act is
`_git_status_snapshot()`; rank 0 **alone** then writes `reports/p2/train_stage1_production.json` — git-tracked
since `082f8c7`, and its bytes always differ from HEAD's (`SCHEMA_VERSION 2` vs the committed `1`, plus two new
gate keys). With **no** `dist.barrier()` anywhere in the file (grep-confirmed), a rank reaching its snapshot
**after** rank 0's write reads the freshly-dirtied report as modified code outside
`_DATA_STAGING_PREFIXES = ("data/",)` → `provenance_complete` FALSE → `overall_pass` FALSE → `RuntimeError` on
that rank → torchrun rc ≠ 0 → the EXIT trap wipes `$BUILD` with the checkpoint inside, **~20 GPU-h lost at the
finish line**. Measured on the cluster in `tbox-ml-dna`: `_git_status_snapshot()` median **11.1 ms**; rank 0's
snapshot→write segment (a 321.8 KB report carrying 14,270 losses) median **31.6 ms**, tail **509.7 ms** — a rank
drifting > 31.6 ms past rank 0 loses the run, well inside the unsynchronised epilogue's own jitter. Its
deterministic sibling needs no race: a *successful* run leaves the checkout permanently dirty at that tracked
report, so any re-submit that does not restore it re-derives FALSE **on all 8 ranks**.

**Outputs.** A new `_barrier_before_primary_write()` — `import torch.distributed as dist; if dist.is_initialized(): dist.barrier()`
— called in the epilogue **between** `validate_report` and the `is_primary()` write, so every rank's snapshot
(taken inside `build_report`, before the barrier) provably precedes the one write: the race closes **by
construction, not by out-racing 31.6 ms**. The guard makes the single-process local smoke a clean no-op. The
sbatch now **restores** `$REPORT` to HEAD before training (`git ls-files --error-unmatch` → `git checkout HEAD --`;
**restore, never `rm`** — deleting dirties the tree just the same, the P2-10d′-c ruling), so run #2 is idempotent
regardless of whether the operator re-ran the LFS-trap `git reset --hard`. `.gitignore` gained this job's four
run signals (`train_stage1_production.DONE`, `.train_production.lock`, `train_production_*.out|err`) — every
sibling job ignored its own, this one did not. And `measure_junction_control.py`'s decoy-arm sizing predicate,
extracted to a testable `decoy_sizes_embedded_arm` reading every cell through **`masking.row_text`** — the last
`str(x or "")` in the decoy/§9.2-admission path (four unrelated instances survive elsewhere in `src/`:
`anchors.py` genus, `synth/tier2n.py` parent seq, `train_stage1.py` schema-version string, `mining/pool.py`
context seq — none reads a fold/id key, none in this step's scope). Under pandas 3 the old idiom read a NaN
`source_record_id` as the literal parent `"nan"`, sizing the arm at **702** while `embed_decoy_rows` (already on
`row_text`) admitted **3,701**, so `unique_hosts=True` died "702 hosts cannot carry 703" on the training env; the
committed `junction_control.json`, built under pandas 2.3.3, is **unchanged** (`row_text ≡ str(x or "")` for
string cells under pandas 2) and its re-run belongs to the next session's pre-ack sequence, now unblocked.

**Validation.** Full unit suite **1,893 passed / 143 skipped / 8 xfailed** (the 8 are the pre-existing P2-10d′-c
census; `train_production.sbatch` is **not** among them); ruff, black, `snakemake --lint`/`-n` clean; `bash -n`
clean on all **10** sbatch files (the roadmap's "11" was a stale count). The load-bearing barrier test is a real
**2-rank gloo** race on a temp git repo, run LOCAL in `tbox-ml-dna` (4 passed, 6.6 s): the straggler observes rank
0's write **without** the barrier (dirty) and its snapshot **precedes** the write **with** it (clean) — the
"rank-ordering forced" gate that fails without the fix and passes with it. **Seven sabotages each redden their
named test(s):** removing the epilogue call → `test_epilogue_barriers_between_validate_and_the_primary_write`;
the helper barrier → no-op → the guard test **and** the gloo behavioural test; removing the `is_initialized`
guard → the guard test; reverting the predicate to `str(x or "")` → the literal-NaN parametrisation **and** the
AST source-guard; removing the sbatch restore → `test_the_sbatch_restores_the_tracked_report_to_head`; adding
`rm "$REPORT"` → `test_the_sbatch_never_deletes_the_tracked_report` **and** the census
`test_no_sbatch_deletes_a_git_tracked_path[train_production.sbatch]`; removing a `.gitignore` signal →
`test_every_production_run_signal_is_gitignored`. Two of my own tests were caught vacuous **before** shipping and
fixed: the guard test first read `inspect.getsource` (fooled by the docstring's own `dist.is_initialized()`
mention → passed with the code-guard removed) and the predicate source-guard tripped on the docstring quoting the
banned idiom — both rewritten to inspect the **AST**, docstring inert ([[degenerate-fixture-generators]]).

**Decisions.** No ADR — the fix **restores** what ADR-0005 A7 already pins (the run's composition and its clean
provenance); no sign-off owed. `_DATA_STAGING_PREFIXES` deliberately **not** widened — that would blind the
clause to genuine `reports/` dirt, the one thing it exists to catch. The barrier is placed AFTER
`validate_report` (not before `build_report`) so every rank that passes validation participates and the collective
cannot half-fire.

**Still open:** the SLURM submit-ack, carried from P2-10d′-b. No training run has been launched — the next session
re-runs the §9.3 sequence (sync → re-stage the LFS split table + the two negative parquets → `--test-only` → ack).

**Commit.** squash **`5e29197`** on `main` (PR [#70](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/70)); feature-branch commit on `p2-10d-prime-e`. *(Reconciled at the P2-15 exit gate: this stanza carried no `Commit.` line.)*

## Step P2-10d′-b (SLURM half) — 2026-07-21: launch + land the round-0 production Stage-1 retrain on the §9.1 seed-negative mix

**Inputs.** Five staged parquets — `context_v0`, `labels_v0` (DVC), `split_assignments` (git-LFS), and the P2-10d′-a substrate `mining_pool_v0` + `decoys_v0` (DVC) — the P2-06 winner config (γ=0.5, `optim.lr=3e-4`, α=0.5), `slurm/p2/train_production.sbatch`, and a **cold start** (`init_from_checkpoint=null`, ADR-0005 A7 pin 8). **Process.** The §9.3 pre-ack sequence re-ran clean end-to-end: cluster synced to `5e29197`; **5/5 parquets `staged-ok`** by *executing the sbatch's own* `assert_dvc_artifact`/`assert_lfs_artifact` block (only the LFS split table needed re-staging after `git reset --hard`); the sbatch's **own 16 extracted override tokens** composed in `tbox-ml-dna` on the cluster (`_cfg_from_mapping` builds `Stage1TrainConfig`, no struct-mode rejection — the job-669 catch); `sbatch --test-only` → job 679 on idle node `one`. On the one-shot `submit` ack, **job 680** trained DDP×8 fp32 over the full 8,303-record D5 fold on node `one`, ~2.4 h wall (17:11→19:33 local), no `PENDING` wait. Retrieved to the laptop and landed via worktree (`cp` + `dvc commit`, never re-run — [[dvc-artifact-worktree-rematerialize]]). **Outputs.** Checkpoint `data/processed/checkpoints/stage1_production/` (dir md5 `91bd49dd91997b8a94b6ba262afab071`, `stage1.pt` sha256 `09931a22…`) + its in-dir `provenance.json` (`git_sha 5e29197`, env-lock `70b66801…`, seed 42); the git-tracked report `reports/p2/train_stage1_production.json` (`schema_version 2`); W&B offline run `ijo945vb`. Supersedes P2-09 as the P2-10e round-0 parent; P2-09 retained as the pre-mix baseline.

**Validation.** `overall_pass=True`, all **9** gate clauses green — including **`provenance_complete=True`** with **`git_dirty_paths=<none>`**, i.e. the P2-10d′-e `dist.barrier()` held **in production** and the ~20 GPU-h DDP snapshot race did not fire. Realized mix is the exact A7-pin-1 identity: stream `n_negative` **83,030** = 10 × `n_positive` 8,303, `realized_negative_fraction` 0.90909 == requested 10/11. A7-pin-3 composition **restored** (the P2-10d′-c pandas-3 fix held on the training env): `n_embedded_by_pool = {dinuc_shuffled: 702, structured_rna: 2999}` = **3,701**, junction-symmetric rate **0.190685** == the committed `junction_control.json` reference (the bug produced 702-only / 0.04278). Cold start asserted: `init_from_checkpoint=None`. verification: **artifact-based** (`sacct` off) — `squeue` empty + `.DONE` + checkpoint + provenance + the self-validating report. **Decisions.** Precision honesty scope **fp32 / TF32-off / no bf16** (ADR-0002 A7), despite imp.md's descriptive "bf16/TF32" wording. **No ADR** — the run realizes the composition A7 already pins. **Owed (post-run, not this step):** ADR-0005 **A7 pin 7 tier-2** — score this checkpoint on the three junction arms and apply `eval/junction_probe.model_side_pass`. **Commit.** squash **`dd253ad`** on `main` (PR [#71](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/71)); feature-branch commit, subject `feat(train): P2-10d′-b round-0 production retrain (job 680) + §9.1 seed-mix checkpoint`

## Step P2-10c′-a — 2026-07-22: the ρ-pilot genome-selection manifest (ADR-0003 D6 sizing pilot, selection half)

**Inputs.** The pinned GTDB **R232** species-rep crosswalk `data/external/gtdb/sp_clusters_r232.tsv` (MD5-verified, `sha256 96414cdc…`, staged by `pin_gtdb_release`; ADR-0003 A1) — one row per species cluster → representative genome + GTDB lineage. **Process.** `workflow/rules/data.smk::select_pilot_genomes` → `src/tbox_finder/mining/pilot_genomes.py::build` streams the ~50 MB crosswalk, groups the 199,923 reps by GTDB phylum, fixes a per-phylum seeded shuffle, and draws **round-robin** (one rep per phylum per pass, phyla ordered by descending rep-count) until `n_target=100` — so the sample spans the maximum number of divergent clades the target allows. It fetches no genomes and scans nothing: the **selection half** only, choosing **no** Stage-1 detection threshold and measuring **no** ρ (both belong to the downstream SLURM scan sub-step where ρ is finally measured), so it pins no ADR value and carries no scientific claim (§10.3). **Outputs.** `data/processed/pilot/pilot_genomes_v0.parquet` (DVC; 100 rows × 7 cols: `assembly_accession`, `gtdb_accession`, `domain`, `phylum`, `gtdb_species`, `gtdb_taxonomy`, `selection_rank`) + its `provenance.json` (git) + `data/processed/audits/pilot_genomes_report.json` (git). Selection: **100 genomes spanning 100 of 197 phyla, 82 bacteria + 18 archaea**, seed 42.

**Validation.** Unit suite `tests/unit/test_pilot_genomes.py` (13 cases) green — parse of a 33-row real-GTDB fixture, phylum-stratification (per-phylum cap honored), breadth-first coverage, content determinism (`assert_frame_equal` across two builds), a cap-binding regression guard (CodeRabbit r1: `expected` uses `sum(min(cap, size))`, not the raw rep total), the anti-vacuous check that the seed genuinely changes a multi-rep phylum's representative, and **two must-fire sabotage guards** (a collapsed single-phylum crosswalk → the `min_phyla` guard raises; a bacteria-only crosswalk → the `archaeal stretch` guard raises) ([[degenerate-fixture-generators]], [[vacuous-test-perturbations]]). No local env carries pytest, so the logic was also exercised by a standalone runner in `tbox-finder-data` (17 checks pass); the pytest file runs in CI. ruff + black (`uvx black@25.11.0`) + `snakemake --lint`/`-n` clean. **Decisions.** **No ADR** — this concretises the ADR-0003 D6 pilot already pinned ("~100-genome sample spanning divergent clades"); the knobs (n_target≈100, seed 42, per-phylum cap 5, non-vacuity floors min_phyla=50 / min_archaea=3) are reproducible engineering recorded in provenance, not new pins. The scheme spans clade **breadth** (round-robin) rather than matching the scan target's phylum composition, because ρ's use is a **conservative** (high-percentile) fetch size and breadth captures the cross-clade variance. Manifest DVC-tracked (parquet), provenance + report git-tracked — the `mining_pool` split. **Owed next (the ρ-pilot is multi-step):** a LOCAL whole-genome fetch (adapt the `flank_context` Entrez path — no whole-genome fetcher exists yet) → the SLURM A4000 scan + a candidate-caller (threshold + min-span + gap-merge, currently unimplemented in `infer/scan.py`) → ρ; ρ then sizes the shared GTDB/RefSeq homolog-DB + negative-window fetch (P2-10c′/P2-10e, 0.7–68 GB). **Commit.** squash **`b571970`** on `main` (PR [#72](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/72)); feature-branch commit on `p2-10cp-a-rho-pilot-genomes`


## Step P2-10c′-b — 2026-07-22: the ρ-pilot LOCAL whole-genome fetch (ADR-0003 D6 sizing pilot, fetch half)

**Inputs.** `data/processed/pilot/pilot_genomes_v0.parquet` (the P2-10c′-a manifest — 100 GTDB R232 species-rep accessions: **92 GCA/GenBank + 8 GCF/RefSeq**, 82 bacteria + 18 archaea) and the user's `NCBI_EMAIL` + API key (`~/.ncbi_env`, 10 req/s). **Process.** New `src/tbox_finder/mining/pilot_fetch.py` + `workflow/rules/data.smk::fetch_pilot_genomes` fetch the whole-genome sequence for each accession so the SLURM scan (P2-10c′-c) can later measure ρ = candidates/Mbp. **A GTDB manifest carries *assembly* accessions, not nuccore ids**, so the module adds assembly→whole-genome resolution. The originally-planned `elink(assembly→nuccore) + efetch` path was **rejected after a measured probe**: ~50 % of this manifest's GCA accessions are **MAGs whose contigs are not elinked at all** — only a sequence-free WGS *master* placeholder (e.g. `VYFG00000000`, `Length=None`) is linked — so `elink+efetch` cannot reach their sequence. The path used instead is `esearch(db=assembly)` → `esummary` **FtpPath** → HTTPS GET `<…>_genomic.fna.gz` → gunzip, the canonical NCBI genome download that carries **every** contig for complete genomes and MAGs alike (stdlib `urllib`+`gzip`, **no env amendment**), with gzip's CRC making a truncated download **raise** rather than silently understate `total_bp`. The E-utilities transport (rate limiter, worker count, `_entrez`, transient-vs-permanent 4xx split) is **reused verbatim** from `flank_context` ([[promote-dont-duplicate-is-a-correctness-rule]]). Fetches genome **SIZE (bp) only** — no ρ, no candidate count, no detection threshold (§10.3). **Outputs.** `data/interim/pilot_genomes/` (100 `.fna`, **281 MB**; DVC dir md5 `5bb9d9c8a6c400ce86df46e9226e3ad3.dir`, 100 files) + `data/interim/pilot_genomes.provenance.json` (git; `digest 3fb6db27…`, `git_sha b571970`, env-lock `a4a67…`) + `data/processed/audits/pilot_fetch_report.json` (git) + a resumable `pilot_genomes_fetch_log.jsonl` (gitignored). **Result: 100/100 ok, success_rate 1.0, 287.76 Mbp across all 100 phyla** (258.3 Mbp bacteria + 29.5 Mbp archaea); genome size **0.52–7.07 Mbp (median 2.49)**; replicons **1–664 (median 105; 16,476 total)** — the 664-contig genomes are exactly the MAGs `elink` could not have reached.

**Validation.** Fail-closed `validate_report` (every headline re-derived from the per-genome evidence rows — the P1-15/P1-16 lesson) passes clean on the written report: `success_rate 1.0 ≥ MIN_SUCCESS_RATE 0.90`; `n_phyla_spanned_ok 100 ≥ MIN_PHYLA_OK 50` (divergence survived the fetch); every ok row carries `total_bp>0` + `n_replicons>0` + a 64-hex `seq_sha256`; honesty flags `rho_measured/candidates_counted/is_science/sequences_synthetic` all `False`; the source block pins the NCBI hosts; `digest` re-derives. Unit suite `tests/unit/test_pilot_fetch.py` (**28 cases**, two-tier: pure bare-CI resolution/parse/status/digest + fail-closed validator bite tests, and an offline end-to-end `build_pilot_fetch` driven by a *fake* Entrez esearch/esummary + a *fake* `urlopen` gzip). **Four must-fire guards sabotage-verified to bite** (fabricated-ok, `MIN_PHYLA_OK`, `MIN_SUCCESS_RATE`, replicon-sort determinism). Full unit suite **1934 passed / 143 skipped / 8 xfailed** (no regressions); ruff + black (`uvx black@25.11.0`) + `snakemake --lint`/`-n` clean. A pre-fetch **adversarial review** (5 lenses × verify) surfaced 6 confirmed defects, all fixed: the efetch-completeness gap (mooted by the gzip pivot), the `directory()` output that would let Snakemake `rmtree` fetched genomes on a failed run (the dir is **not** a Snakemake output — a resumable side-product like `fetch_cache.jsonl`), orphan-FASTA reconciliation (the on-disk `.fna` set must equal the certified ok set, else §7 stop — never `rm`, [[sbatch-rm-of-tracked-path-fails-own-gate]]), and replicon-order canonicalization for byte-deterministic DVC content. **Decisions.** **No ADR** — this concretises the ADR-0003 D6 pilot already pinned; it pins no value and carries no scientific claim (no ρ measured — that is the SLURM scan sub-step). The elink→FTP pivot is a standard engineering choice (LOCAL, no env/ADR/scope change) forced by the measured MAG-elink finding. Operational floors (`MIN_SUCCESS_RATE 0.90`, `MIN_PHYLA_OK 50`) are frozen implementer choices (the `flank_context.MIN_ANCHOR_RATE` precedent), not PRD/ADR pins. **Owed next:** **P2-10c′-c** — the SLURM A4000 scan (Caduceus Mamba sm_86; WSL2 CUDA fails on large RNA) + a candidate-caller (threshold + min-span + gap-merge — unimplemented in `infer/scan.py`) → **ρ = candidates / 287.76 Mbp**; ρ then sizes the 0.7–68 GB P2-10c′/P2-10e homolog-DB + negative-window fetch. `dvc push` deferred to the phase-exit gate (§5.2). **Commit.** squash **`400a034`** on `main` (PR [#73](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/73)); feature-branch commit on `p2-10cp-b-pilot-fetch`


## Step P2-10c′-c-i — 2026-07-22: the along-sequence candidate-caller (ρ-pilot scan sub-step 1 of 2)

**Inputs.** `src/tbox_finder/infer/scan.py::scan_sequence` (per-position reconciled posteriors, `Reconciled.log_probs` `(seq_len, 8)` + `zero_flanked`) and the ADR-0005 D3+A3 reduction it stops at; the label class order (index 0 = `background`, 1..7 the T-box elements). **Process.** P2-10c′-c (the SLURM A4000 scan → ρ) opened on a **§7 design decision** the roadmap pre-flagged: ρ = "Stage-1 candidates/Mbp" (ADR-0003 D6) needs a candidate-caller **and** a threshold, yet ADR-0005 **D3 freezes the production Stage-1 threshold at the phase gate (§13.1), never at a sizing pilot**, and the D3 recall-floor calibration harness is **absent** (a survey confirmed: only generic matched-precision PR primitives in `metrics.py`, not per-locus, not the ≥99% floor). Two options were framed with a recommendation and put to the user; **decision 2026-07-22: (1) sweep ρ(τ), pin nothing; (2) minimal recall-favouring caller.** This sub-step lands the caller half only (LOCAL, decision-free post-sign-off); the SLURM scan + ρ ingest is **-c-ii** (an §9.3 submit-ack step). New `src/tbox_finder/infer/call.py` (numpy-only, torch-free → bare CI Tier-1, like `reconcile`): element score `p_elem = 1 − exp(log_probs[:, background])` (global scope, **no** required-element co-occurrence — D3 warns mandating canonical elements re-imposes the §5/§13.3 bias, and the flagship class is the *non-canonical* Tier-2N T-box), binarise at τ (`>=`, inclusive), gap-merge runs separated by `<= gap_merge` background positions, keep merged runs of `>= min_span`; each run one `Candidate` (span, peak/mean `p_elem`, `n_zero_flanked`, descriptive `dominant_class`). `τ / min_span / gap_merge` are keyword-only **with no defaults** (a production value cannot be taken by accident — [[peft-suffix-minimises-target-modules]] discipline); a `sweep_candidate_counts` helper reuses one forward across a τ×min_span×gap_merge grid (the GPU cost is the threshold-independent forward, so -c-ii forwards each genome once and calls this cheaply). Contig ends are **flagged, not dropped** (`n_zero_flanked` recorded; recall-favouring keeps a call whose context included pad — never a silent drop, §10.3). **Outputs.** `src/tbox_finder/infer/call.py` + `tests/unit/test_infer_call.py`; `infer/__init__` docstring/`__all__` extended. Pins **no** ADR value, measures **no** ρ (the scan is -c-ii), carries no scientific claim.

**Validation.** The three boundary invariants (`>=` threshold, `<=` gap-merge, `>=` min-span) each carry a property test **plus** a must-fire sabotage partner (an independent reference caller with that one decision flipped, shown to diverge on a crafted fixture — the [[tests-can-specify-the-bug]] / anti-tautology discipline); reference-match across a 27-point random-fixture grid with an expressiveness guard ([[degenerate-fixture-generators]]); recall-favouring behaviour (a single-element run *is* called), zero-flank flag-not-drop, keyword-only/no-default guards, range validation, determinism, sweep↔single-point consistency. No local env carries pytest (the unit tier is CI-only locally), so the logic was exercised by a standalone runner in `tbox-finder-data` (**26 checks pass**) **and** the shipped `call.py` was source-sabotaged three ways (`>=`→`>`, `<=`→`<`, `<`→`<=`), each shown to **BIT** the crafted case then cleanly restored (`python -B` + pycache-clear, [[sabotage-restores-masked-by-pycache]]); the committed pytest file runs in CI. ruff 0.15.15 + black 25.11.0 clean (B905 `zip(strict=True)` added). **Decisions.** **No ADR** — a scope-guarded sizing tool that pins nothing (the -a/-b precedent), so no ADR-0005 amendment is owed *now*; **when this operator is promoted to the phase-gate production locus-constructor, that promotion owes an A-series amendment** documenting the frozen values (the A3 precedent for the D3 reconciliation operator). Global (not per-class) threshold scope + no co-occurrence is the most-liberal reading → ρ a **conservative upper bound** on the fetch (the safe direction). **Owed next: P2-10c′-c-ii** — a SLURM A4000 scan sbatch (Caduceus Mamba sm_86; WSL2 CUDA fails on large RNA) forwarding the 100 pilot genomes (287.76 Mbp) with the job-680 checkpoint, calling `sweep_candidate_counts` per genome → the ρ(τ, min_span, gap_merge) surface = ρ; ρ then sizes the 0.7–68 GB homolog-DB + negative-window fetch. Carries a §9.3 submit-ack. **Commit.** squash **`73764ca`** on `main` (PR [#74](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/74)); feature-branch commit on `p2-10cp-c-candidate-caller`

## Step P2-10c′-c-ii — 2026-07-22: the ρ-pilot SLURM scan driver + sbatch (ρ-pilot scan sub-step 2 of 2)

**Inputs.** `src/tbox_finder/infer/scan.py` (`load_stage1_checkpoint`, `scan_sequence` → `Reconciled.log_probs`/`zero_flanked`) and `infer/call.py::sweep_candidate_counts` (numpy-only, the -c-i caller); the 100 pilot genomes `data/interim/pilot_genomes/` (287.76 Mbp, P2-10c′-b, DVC); the job-680 production checkpoint `data/processed/checkpoints/stage1_production/stage1.pt` (sha256 `09931a22…`, DVC); the git-tracked manifest `data/processed/audits/pilot_fetch_report.json` (`total_bp` 287,764,740). **Process.** This is the last **runnable** sub-step of the "unblock mining properly" arc: measure ρ = Stage-1 candidates/Mbp (ADR-0003 **D6**), the unmeasured pivot that sizes the 0.7–68 GB homolog-DB + negative-window fetch (P2-10c′). The whole inference path already existed (`scan.py` transport + `call.py` caller — [[promote-dont-duplicate-is-a-correctness-rule]]), so the step is orchestration + a SLURM job, not new model code. New `src/tbox_finder/infer/rho_pilot.py`: a **torch-free** aggregation/report surface (numpy/stdlib; torch imported lazily inside the two GPU legs, like `scan.py`) — stdlib `parse_fasta` that **upper-cases** every contig (load-bearing: `window_dataset.encode_bases` maps lowercase/IUPAC/`N`→the `N` token, so a soft-masked genome would silently become all-`N`; the ml-dna env has no biopython — confirmed by recon), deterministic **LPT-by-size** `assign_shards`, a `grid_order` that reproduces `sweep_candidate_counts`'s emission order, the pure `sum_arrays` ρ-surface accumulator, and fail-closed `build_report`/`validate_report` mirroring `mining/pilot_fetch.py` (every headline re-derived from the per-genome evidence). GPU legs `scan_genome`/`scan_shard` (behind lazy torch import); `reduce_partials` globs the shard partials → the one git-tracked `data/processed/pilot/rho_pilot_report.json` + provenance. New `slurm/p2/scan_pilot.sbatch`: **embarrassingly parallel, NO DDP** (adapting `train_production.sbatch`'s staging/singleton/marker discipline) — env `tbox-ml-dna`, `--gres=gpu:a4000:4`, one single-GPU `scan-shard` worker per allocated A4000 (worker *i* → `cuda:i`, K read from `nvidia-smi -L`), per-shard `SHARD_OK`/`.err` in node-local `/tmp`, then a `reduce`. Reuses the `selective_scan_cuda`-after-`torch` import-order guard (killed job 567) + the HF-cache prewarm; verifies the checkpoint by its committed **sha256** (a `.dir` DVC hash cannot md5 a single file) and the genome set by count + FASTA magic; **never `rm`s** the git-tracked report (restores it to HEAD instead — the P2-10d′-c lesson). Sharding is a bespoke per-GPU-worker launcher (no repo template splits a node into single-GPU workers — recon confirmed both existing p2 sbatch give the whole node to torchrun); `cuda:i` indexing (all K GPUs visible, worker pins its own) is robust to the cgroup CVD-reindex ambiguity. **Owed next: the §9.3 submit-ack** (K=4 A4000, est ≤ ~2.2 h wall at the conservative 18.8 win/s/GPU training floor, `--time=04:00:00` ceiling; inference `no_grad` is strictly faster) → job runs → retrieve + `dvc add` the report → ρ then sizes the P2-10c′ homolog-DB fetch (0.7–68 GB). **Commit.** squash **`e015a9b`** on `main` (PR [#75](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/75)); feature-branch commit on `p2-scan-pilot`

**Addendum (job 685 fix-up, 2026-07-22).** First submit (job 685, node `one`, ~20 min) FAILED at the launcher: `nvidia-smi -L | wc -l` counted all **8** physical A4000 on the node (nvidia-smi ignores the `--gres` allocation), so K=8 workers launched, but torch honours the SLURM `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` (the **4** allocated) — workers 4–7 pinned `cuda:4..7` and died `RuntimeError: CUDA error: invalid device ordinal`. Re-submit carries a fresh §9.3 ack.

Pins no ADR value, asserts no claim (ADR-0003 D6 / ADR-0005 D3). **Commit.** squash **`e015a9b`** on `main` (PR [#75](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/75)); feature-branch report commit on `p2-scan-pilot`

## Step P2-10c′-d — 2026-07-23: the off-catalogue cmsearch substrate pre-scan gate (ADR-0005 A8, masking machinery)

**Inputs.** The signed masking-decision source `P2-10cprime-masking-adr-drafts.md` (approved 2026-07-23); `src/tbox_finder/infernal.py` (the single `cmsearch`/`parse_tblout`/`write_fasta` caller — reused, not forked); `src/tbox_finder/masking.py` (the fail-open-off-catalogue paths + the `accession_namespace_report` no-op guard); `src/tbox_finder/decoys.py:720-728` (the two-armed `consumed==expected` guard); `src/tbox_finder/infer/rho_pilot.py` (the `build_report`/`validate_report` re-derivation idiom mirrored here); `reports/p2/tier2n_probe.json` (`cm_sha256`, `parent_miss_rate 0.276`, `n_natural 0`); `data/external/refs/RF00230.cm` (sha256 `082616ef…52cea`) + `RF00230_master.fa` (12,287 real T-boxes for the spike arm); ADR-0005 A7's `junction_symmetry_clauses` shape [ADR-0005:436]. **Process.** Encodes ADR-0005 **A8** — the union-prior mask (A6/A7) is **fail-open off-catalogue** (every GTDB/RefSeq accession is off-catalogue, so `is_masked`/`matches_interval_exactly` return `False` and an unmatched window is classed *minable*), so the P2-10c′ independent-genome negative substrate is gated by a **model-independent, SHARD-AWARE cmsearch pre-scan** whose versioned report carries **8 same-artifact must-fire clauses**. New `src/tbox_finder/mining/substrate_prescan.py` (torch-free stdlib + `infernal`/`provenance`): `build_shard_segment` reduces ONE shard's ONE `cmsearch --tblout` (production + folded-in matched spike/null control arms) to a segment — hits joined to windows by **exact whitespace-free name** (the pin-2/pin-3 deflation guard), an `invocation_id` **re-derived from the tblout's own data rows** (path/date-independent, so all three arms share it *because they parsed one file*), the loaded CM's sha256; `derive_clauses` (the builder/validator-**shared** re-derivation, never read back from config) computes the 8 booleans; `build_report`/`validate_report` (never raises, `[]==valid`, `overall_pass=all(REQUIRED_CLAUSES)`, a MISSING clause key is a HARD FAIL, `CLAUSE_SCHEMA_VERSION`-gated) + `reduce` (writes only if it certifies — the rho_pilot precedent). The recall-favouring threshold is a *rule* (`cut_ga=False`); the numeric `score_threshold` is keyword-required with **no default** (§10.3, ADR-0005 D3 pattern). New `scripts/make_substrate_prescan_control.py` (deterministic `shake_256` spike = real T-box embedded in background, null = composition-preserving shuffle → matchedness asserted, generator refuses to emit an unmatched arm); `slurm/p2/substrate_prescan.sbatch` (SLURM `--array`, CPU-only on the `gpu` partition, env `tbox-infernal`, per-shard `SHARD_OK`, stale-marker-clear-first per the P2-10c′-c-ii fix; reduce is the documented LOCAL follow-up). **No substrate is fetched or scanned (§10.3):** the aggregate `reports/p2/substrate_prescan.json` is produced downstream at P2-10c′/P2-10e; this step ships machinery + tests + the ADR + a real golden fixture only. The **8 clauses**: (i) production `consumed==expected` (full two-armed `decoys.py:720-728`, per shard + aggregate); (ii) per-shard spike removal > 0 (the dead-scan flag, per-shard so it catches one dead shard); (iii) matched arms min-N (20/20) + matchedness; (iv) STRICT `removal(spike)−removal(null) > MARGIN`; (v) unique-name + total hit→window join (the `.N`-suffix no-op guard); (vi) shard-count + `SHARD_OK` + one-tblout co-invocation (id-equality from one file); (vii) CM-identity per invocation (fires independently of vi); (viii) genome completeness vs the **git-frozen** selection manifest + an enumerated within-genome no-shrink clause with a pinned maiden-fetch baseline. **Outputs.** `src/tbox_finder/mining/substrate_prescan.py`, `scripts/make_substrate_prescan_control.py`, `slurm/p2/substrate_prescan.sbatch`, `tests/unit/test_substrate_prescan.py`, `tests/ml/test_substrate_prescan_control.py`, `tests/fixtures/substrate_prescan/` (golden report + control manifest + shard specs + **real** committed `.tblout` + selection accessions), `docs/decisions/ADR-0005-*.md` (A8 appended, ☑ signed), `.gitignore` (runtime segment/log dirs; the committed report NOT ignored), and a PRD §9.1 supplement note (local-only). Pins no numeric detection threshold; asserts no contamination value.

**Validation.** The golden fixture was minted by a **real local cmsearch run** (§8.7: real T-boxes, real pipeline, no mocking) — over 2 shards it recovered **all 40 embedded spike T-boxes ([20,20]) and zero matched-shuffle nulls ([0,0])**, production removal `0.0` (the admissible low-removal case), all 8 clauses green, `overall_pass=true`; it is **deterministically reproducible** (invocation_id derived from tblout data rows, identical across re-mints). Unit suite `tests/unit/test_substrate_prescan.py` (**27 cases**): a healthy scenario certifies + is expressive (spike separated), then **every one of the 8 clauses has a must-fire sabotage that flips exactly it FALSE** (consumed≠expected, emptiness, dead-shard spike, below-min-N, unmatched-null, copy-spike-into-null, dead-both-arms, duplicate-name, unjoined-hit, real-build name-mismatch deflation, missing-shard, `shard_ok` false, two-tblout, split invocation_id, wrong-CM, dropped-genome, within-genome-shrink), plus the clause-completeness HARD-FAIL, `CLAUSE_SCHEMA_VERSION`-bump invalidation, `overall_pass`-forgery, re-summed-headline, and `reduce` refuses to write a non-certifying report. ML gate `tests/ml/test_substrate_prescan_control.py` (**7 cases**): validates the committed real golden report end-to-end, rebuilds a shard from the real committed `.tblout` (exercises `parse_tblout` on real cmsearch output in bare CI), generator matchedness + sabotage, and a `TBOX_REQUIRE_INFERNAL` **live** cmsearch re-scan (skips in bare CI, ran locally: real detector re-separated spike from null). No local pytest env, so both suites ran via a standalone runner in `tbox-finder-infernal` (py3.12) with a minimal `pytest` shim — **27 + 7 pass** (live variant included); the committed pytest files run the real suites in CI. ruff 0.15.22 + `black@25.11.0` clean (line-length 100); sbatch `bash -n` clean and verified NOT to trip the `test_sbatch_rm_targets.py` gate (its `rm` targets resolve to untracked `reports/p2/substrate_prescan_segments/shard_*.{OK,json}` and `/tmp` scratch). **Decisions.** **ADR-0005 A8 signed 2026-07-23** — a design pin (no compute, no measured number); it amends D14's masking clause for independent genomes and re-scopes the union mask to on-catalogue only, **supplementing** (not replacing) PRD:190's union-denominator residual (a PRD > ADR scope clarification, signed as part of A8). The reported `substrate_removal_rate` is a removal/detection **yield** that one-sided *lower*-bounds true contamination (cmsearch misses ~27.6 % + Tier-2N by definition), **never a residual or a clean-pool claim**; residual Tier-2N contamination stays **UNMEASURED above** (disclosed), with the D14 per-round halt the directional backstop. Does **not** co-pin `infernal` with `hmmer` (the genuine `esl-*` clobber — that is the separate ADR-0002 A12 env step); does **not** touch the §9.2 order-negatives question (the separate a1+b2 decision). `dvc push` n/a (no data artifact). **Owed next (this encode arc):** ADR-0002 **A12** (`envs/homology.yml`: hmmer/blast) + the **a1+b2** §9.2 encode (ADR-0004 + PRD §9.2 + the CI clause), each its own worktree+PR; then P2-10c′ (the ρ-sized SLURM fetch, carrying its acquisition ack) can proceed. **Commit.** squash **`86dbc3f`** on `main` (PR [#76](https://github.com/bioedca/tbox-finder/pull/76)); feature-branch commit on `p2-10cprime-d-substrate-prescan`

False`): **reuse-not-fork** — the tiler is `window_dataset.tile_windows` (a contig ≤ 1024 nt → one un-padded window, no minimum-window drop, the trailing window anchored to the 3′ end; empty contigs skipped), the FASTA parser + LPT-by-`n_windows` sharder + provenance writer are the existing shared ones; nothing re-implemented (a drift-guard asserts `window_dataset` geometry == `substrate_prescan` geometry).
